Name: $projectName$
Description: Baserow Rulebook seed: a rulebook extracted from a Baserow database, plus everything that can be derived from it. The rulebook arrives extracted; re-pull it with `effortless build -id` when you want the rulebook to follow the source again.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: baserow-to-rulebook
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Input spoke: re-extract the rulebook from the Baserow database. Disabled on purpose -- the rulebook arrives already extracted; add -p apiKey=<your database token> locally and run `effortless build -id` to pull again.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: compile-rulebook
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Validate the rulebook and compute every calculated field

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebook-to-postgres
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the Postgres schema, views, functions and seed data

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebook-to-markdown
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Human-readable documentation of every table, field and rule

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebook-to-rulespeak
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Business-readable RuleSpeak statements of every rule

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebook-to-explainer-dag
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Interactive dependency graph of every derived value

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebook-to-xlsx
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Excel workbook with the model and live formulas

ProjectTranspilers.Name: effortless-rulebook-editor
ProjectTranspilers.Description: The browser rulebook editor: Docker image with Postgres, the generated API and the editing UI
